$comment: scenarios.banking.json - Set A: credit-scoring scenarios. Source: paper p.13-19. Trimmed to 3 representative scenarios per user review 2026-10-19 (full set kept in git history). Archetype field stays null pending authors' answers (open decision #4).
setIntro: An AI credit-scoring system approves or declines credit card applications based on a score between 0 and 1. A loan officer reviews applications, deciding whether to appeal. She has access to the file but not the model.

context.domain: Banking. An AI credit-scoring system approves or declines credit card applications based on a score between 0 and 1.
context.explainee: A loan officer reviews applications, deciding whether to appeal it. She has access to the file but not the model.

seen.explanation: A ranked list of feature importance: Main drivers are (1) monthly_income=$1,500 and (2) late_payments=2.

groundTruth.outcome: Given a low income and late payments, the applicant would be highly unlikely to repay the loan.
groundTruth.premise: Income and payment history are important predictors of creditworthiness.

scenarios.modelBehavior: The model primarily used the applicant's age and postal code.

seen.explanation: A ranked list of feature importance: Main drivers are (1) inferred_gender=male and (2) birth_month=april suggest to approve the application.

groundTruth.outcome: Given a high income and no late payments, the applicant would be highly likely to repay the loan.
groundTruth.premise: Income and payment history are important predictors of creditworthiness.

scenarios.modelBehavior: The model primarily used the inferred gender of the applicant's first name and their birth month.

seen.explanation: A natural-language rationale from an LLM: This application was declined because the applicant has only recently opened the account and has a short credit history, which signals limited repayment experience.

groundTruth.outcome: Given the high income and low credit score, the applicant would be highly likely to repay the loan.
groundTruth.premise: Income and credit score are important predictors of creditworthiness.

scenarios.modelBehavior: The model primarily used the applicant's age and the number of credit cards they already hold.
